$comment: Hand-maintained input for scripts/generate-ai-issue-catalogs.cjs. After editing, run npm run generate:ai-catalogs and commit the generated files.
issueRules is keyed by Toronto 311 issue title. Issues without a rule are not-discoverable.
An issue's visual cues are its requiredAnyLabelIds, then requiredAllLabelIds, then supportingLabelIds.

When the photo labels change, bump versions.photoLabelTaxonomy and move the old value into versions.olderPhotoLabelTaxonomiesAccepted, so app builds on it keep getting suggestions; remove it once those builds are gone.
